title: Pais patent test at Pax River had no definitive results
place_text: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland

tellings.quote: test form and they admitted that one of them that they did I believe it's the anti-gravidic one but they weren't able to have any definitive results.

plain: In 2025, the military admitted it had tested one of the unusual craft patents filed by Navy engineer Salvatore Pais, he believes the antigravity one, at Patuxent River, a Navy air base in Maryland, but got no definitive results. Congressman Eric Burlison tells Jesse Michels he heard this directly, with Jon Kosloski, head of the Pentagon's office for unexplained aerial reports, named in the account. It matters because it would mean the Navy actually tried to build what the patents describe.
